column1: # Hand-built synonym probe set — PLAN.md task T6b "Done when".
# Measures the PRECISION of the synonym lexicon, which matters more than its
# coverage: a false synonym silently turns tier-3 F1 into nonsense, whereas a
# missing one only costs a point.
# The negatives are deliberately the hard cases — co-hyponyms and antonyms that
# sit close together in any embedding space and that a distributionally-induced
# lexicon (Tier B, X3) will be tempted to merge.  Several of them are the very
# pairs the veto layer must keep apart (অক্সিজেন vs কার্বন ডাই-অক্সাইড, ১৯৭১ vs
# ১৯৫২), so this probe is also an early smoke test for §10.2.
# Columns:  a <TAB> b <TAB> label   (1 = same concept, 0 = different)
# ---- HELD-OUT positives: genuine synonyms deliberately ABSENT from ------
# synonyms.tsv.  Without these the probe would only measure whether the lexicon
# remembers its own contents, and recall would be 1.0 by construction — which
# tells us nothing.  These are ordinary Bangla tatsama/tadbhava doublets a
# speaker would accept; the lexicon is expected to MISS them, and that miss is
# the honest measure of its coverage.  Tier B (X3) is scored on the same rows,
# so "does FastText induction find synonyms a hand list missed?" becomes a
# ---- negatives: co-hyponyms (close in embedding space, NOT equivalent) ---
# ---- negatives: numerals and dates (veto terms, never equivalent) --------
